defs.def: to make sth known to sb 揭示；显示；透露

ex.s: To reveal the beauty of science in an artistic way.
ex.t: 为了以艺术的方式揭示科学之美。

ex.s: Tracking of 150 biochemicals in food has been important in revealing the relationships between calories, sugar, fat and the occurrence of common diseases.
ex.t: 对食物中150种生化物质的追踪在揭示卡路里、糖、脂肪与常见疾病发生之间的关系方面发挥了重要作用。

ex.s: To reveal the beauty of ancient objects.
If I can get so much pleasure from touch, how much more beauty must be revealed by sight?
ex.t: 如果我能从触觉中获得如此多的快乐，那么视觉必定能揭示出多少更多的美啊？

ex.s: I should like to see the books which have been read to me, and which have revealed to me the deepest channels of human life and the human spirit.
ex.t: 我想看看那些读给我听的书，这些书向我揭示了人类生活和人类精神的最深层渠道。

ex.s: Now known as the Heiligenstadt Testament, this letter reveals much about the heart and soul of this great artist.
ex.t: 这封现被称为《海利根施塔特遗书》的信，揭示了这位伟大艺术家的内心和灵魂。

ex.s: His portrait ages and reveals his inner ugliness.
ex.t: 他的画像随着岁月流逝，揭示了他内心的丑陋。

ex.s: Bobby was assessed and his talents was / were revealed to be mostly scientific: a 66% chance of success in chemistry and 54% in physics was / were shown.
ex.t: 对Bobby进行了评估，发现他的才能主要是科学的：在化学方面有66%的成功机会，在物理方面有54%的成功机会。

ex.s: Mathematical models have also revealed that food webs may be unstable， where small changes of top predators can lead to big effects throughout entire ecosystems． In the 1960s， scientists proposed that predators at the top of a food web had a surprising amount of control over the size of populations of other species﹣including species they did not directly attack．
ex.t: 数学模型也揭示，食物网可能不稳定，顶级捕食者的微小变化会在整个生态系统引发巨大效应。20世纪60年代，科学家提出，食物网顶端的捕食者对包括它们不直接攻击的物种在内的其他物种种群规模有着惊人的控制力。

defs.def: to show sth that previously could not be seen 显出；露出；展示

ex.s: Their study revealed that the large number of observation-only records did not lead to better global coverage.
ex.t: 他们的研究表明，大量仅基于观察的记录并没有带来更好的全球覆盖。

chunks.en: reveal beauty / food / inner / large / relationships
chunks.cn: 揭示美丽 / 揭示食物 / 揭示感情等 / 揭示大的 / 揭示
